audit.evidence: Real October CMS per version (Build 468/469/470) via composer + MySQL 8.0 in Docker. External HTTP GET to CMS pages with Twig sandbox-escape payloads. addDynamicMethod escape reads canary on V0 (no sandbox), blocked on V1 (SecurityPolicy introduced). bindEvent bypass reads canary on V1 (bindEvent not in blocklist), confirming incomplete fix. Benign file_get_contents canary only.
